'####################',
'#P.................#',
'#...RBR.WWWWWWWWW..#',
'#WW.W.W.WWWWWWWWW..#',
'#WW W WWWWWWWWWWW..#',
'#WW W WWWWWBWWWWW..#',
'#WWWW  ............#',
'#WWWWE WWWWWWWWWWWW#',
'####################',
]},
aha: The trapdoor can only be dug from below, and when it opens both neighbouring stones roll in after the pearl; the gate's side pocket takes exactly one, so exactly one stone must be sent away first.
deadlocks: Opening the trapdoor with both stones still beside it: one rolls into the pocket, the second lands on the gate and seals it.
Sending both stones away (left into the sump and right onto the ledge): the pocket stays open and the second pearl drops into it.
Pushing the second pearl over the pocket before a stone has filled it.
Lingering in the shaft after digging the trapdoor (crushed by the pearl), or hiding in the pocket (crushed by the stone).
